active.label: Actively homeless
active.note: Counts people who used an overnight service in the City's shelter system (shelters, respite sites, hotel programs) in the last three months and weren't recorded as moving into housing. It doesn't count people sleeping outdoors or using services the City doesn't fund: the City estimates, from its most recent Street Needs Assessment, that about 18% of people experiencing homelessness aren't in this data.
